description: Tool to retrieve Google Signals configuration settings for a GA4 property. Use when you need to check whether Google Signals is enabled and the consent status for a property.

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving Google Signals settings for a property.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the Google Signals settings to retrieve. Must be in the exact format: properties/{property_id}/googleSignalsSettings where property_id is a numeric identifier. IMPORTANT: Must start with 'properties/' prefix, contain no forward slashes in the property_id, have no trailing slashes, and must end with '/googleSignalsSettings'. Valid example: 'properties/1000/googleSignalsSettings'. Invalid examples: '1000' (missing prefix), 'properties/1000' (missing suffix), 'properties/1000/googleSignalsSettings/' (trailing slash)
name.title: Name

inputSchema.title: GetGoogleSignalsSettingsRequest

name: get_google_signals_settings

consent.description: Output only. Terms of Service acceptance status. Possible values: GOOGLE_SIGNALS_CONSENT_UNSPECIFIED (default, treated as not consented), GOOGLE_SIGNALS_CONSENT_CONSENTED (Terms of service have been accepted), GOOGLE_SIGNALS_CONSENT_NOT_CONSENTED (Terms of service have not been accepted).
consent.title: Consent

name.description: Output only. Resource name of this setting. Format: properties/{property_id}/googleSignalsSettings.
name.title: Name

state.description: Indicates whether Google Signals functionality is activated. Possible values: GOOGLE_SIGNALS_STATE_UNSPECIFIED (user has not made explicit selection), GOOGLE_SIGNALS_ENABLED (Google Signals is active), GOOGLE_SIGNALS_DISABLED (Google Signals is inactive).
state.title: State
